meaning: to lack; to be short of

senses.en: to lack; to be short of

examples.zh: 我们公司缺少会说英语的人。
examples.en: Our company lacks people who can speak English.

examples.zh: 这个菜缺少一点儿糖。
examples.en: This dish is short of a little sugar.

examples.zh: 他缺少工作经验，所以没找到工作。
examples.en: He lacks work experience, so he couldn't find a job.

note: Often for welcomes, applause, discussion: 热烈欢迎, 热烈的讨论.

examples.zh: 我们热烈欢迎你来中国。
examples.en: We warmly welcome you to China.

examples.zh: 会议上的讨论很热烈。
examples.en: The discussion at the meeting was lively.

examples.zh: 他们受到了热烈的欢迎。
examples.en: They received a warm welcome.

meaning: ID or official papers (passport, ID card, permit)

senses.en: ID or official papers (passport, ID card, permit)

examples.zh: 坐火车要带证件。
examples.en: You need to bring your ID to take a train.

examples.zh: 我的证件不见了，怎么办？
examples.en: My ID is missing. What should I do?

examples.zh: 住酒店需要护照或其他证件。
examples.en: Staying in a hotel requires a passport or other ID.

meaning: to speak (at a meeting); a speech or statement

senses.en: to speak (at a meeting); a speech or statement

examples.zh: 会议上请大家发言。
examples.en: Please, everyone, speak up at the meeting.

examples.zh: 他的发言很简单，但很清楚。
examples.en: His speech was simple but very clear.

examples.zh: 今天谁先发言？
examples.en: Who speaks first today?

meaning: top; jacket (clothing worn on the upper body)

senses.en: top; jacket (clothing worn on the upper body)

examples.zh: 这件上衣是新买的。
examples.en: This top is newly bought.

examples.zh: 外面冷，你多穿一件上衣。
examples.en: It's cold outside, so put on one more top.

examples.zh: 我想买一件上衣和一条裤子。
examples.en: I want to buy a top and a pair of pants.

examples.zh: 老师带领学生去参观。
examples.en: The teacher leads the students on a visit.

examples.zh: 他带领大家完成了工作。
examples.en: He led everyone to finish the work.

examples.zh: 老师带领我们走进了公园。
examples.en: The teacher led us into the park.

examples.zh: 这个地方的交通还很落后。
examples.en: The transport in this place is still quite backward.

examples.zh: 他的成绩比别人落后一点儿。
examples.en: His grades are a bit behind other people's.

examples.zh: 比赛中，我们队落后两分。
examples.en: In the game, our team is two points behind.

meaning: singing voice; the sound of singing

senses.en: singing voice; the sound of singing

examples.zh: 我听见房间里有歌声。
examples.en: I heard singing in the room.

examples.zh: 她的歌声真好听。
examples.en: Her singing voice is lovely.

examples.zh: 外面传来孩子们的歌声。
examples.en: Children's singing drifts in from outside.

note: Written style; in speech people say 比较.

examples.zh: 北京的冬天较冷。
examples.en: Beijing winters are rather cold.

examples.zh: 这家店的价格较高。
examples.en: The prices at this shop are relatively high.

examples.zh: 今天人较少，我们可以早点吃饭。
examples.en: There are fewer people today, so we can eat earlier.

meaning: to input; to type in (data, text)

senses.en: to input; to type in (data, text)

examples.zh: 请输入你的名字。
examples.en: Please enter your name.

examples.zh: 你会输入汉字吗？
examples.en: Can you type Chinese characters?

examples.zh: 我把电话输入错了。
examples.en: I typed the phone number in wrong.

examples.zh: 这家医院有很先进的设备。
examples.en: This hospital has very advanced equipment.

examples.zh: 他们的技术很先进。
examples.en: Their technology is very advanced.

examples.zh: 这个工厂用了先进的方法。
examples.en: This factory uses advanced methods.

examples.zh: 我对这个概念不太清楚。
examples.en: I'm not very clear about this concept.

examples.zh: 老师又讲了一次这个概念。
examples.en: The teacher went over this concept once more.

examples.zh: 每个人对成功的概念不同。
examples.en: Everyone has a different idea of success.

meaning: to install; to set up (equipment, software)

senses.en: to install; to set up (equipment, software)

examples.zh: 明天有人来给我们安装空调。
examples.en: Someone is coming tomorrow to install the air conditioner.

examples.zh: 这个空调怎么安装？
examples.en: How do I install this air conditioner?

examples.zh: 我的手机上安装了一个新地图。
examples.en: I installed a new map app on my phone.

meaning: to recognize; to know (a person, a character, a road)

senses.en: to recognize; to know (a person, a character, a road)

note: Colloquial; 认识 is more general. Common negative: 不认得.

examples.zh: 你认得这个字吗？
examples.en: Do you recognize this character?

examples.zh: 我不认得路，请你带我去。
examples.en: I don't know the way. Please take me there.

examples.zh: 那个人我认得，他是我的同学。
examples.en: I know that person; he is my classmate.

meaning: to revise; to edit; to change (a text or plan)

senses.en: to revise; to edit; to change (a text or plan)

examples.zh: 我想修改这份报告。
examples.en: I want to revise this report.

examples.zh: 请你帮我修改作文。
examples.en: Please help me edit my essay.

examples.zh: 经理让我修改计划。
examples.en: The manager asked me to revise the plan.

note: Before the verb: 他们分别…, "each in turn". Also 分别 as "to part" is more written.

examples.zh: 他们分别来自北京和上海。
examples.en: They come from Beijing and Shanghai respectively.

examples.zh: 我们在机场分别，以后再见。
examples.en: We said goodbye at the airport and will meet again later.

examples.zh: 老师分别问了每个学生。
examples.en: The teacher asked each student separately.

examples.zh: 这是我们一年的工作成果。
examples.en: This is the result of our year's work.

examples.zh: 他的努力终于有了成果。
examples.en: His efforts have finally paid off.

examples.zh: 这个成果来得不容易。
examples.en: This achievement did not come easily.

examples.zh: 他家在越南的南部。
examples.en: His home is in the south of Vietnam.

examples.zh: 中国南部的冬天不太冷。
examples.en: Winters in southern China aren't too cold.

examples.zh: 这个国家的南部常常下雨。
examples.en: It often rains in the south of this country.

examples.zh: 这道题的难度很高。
examples.en: The difficulty of this question is high.

examples.zh: 汉语考试的难度比我想的大。
examples.en: The Chinese exam is harder than I thought.

examples.zh: 这个游戏有三种难度。
examples.en: This game has three difficulty levels.

note: Separable verb: 和他握手, 握了握手.

examples.zh: 他笑着跟我握手。
examples.en: He smiled and shook hands with me.

examples.zh: 见面的时候，我们握手了。
examples.en: We shook hands when we met.

examples.zh: 比赛前，两个队互相握手。
examples.en: Before the game, the two teams shook hands with each other.
